profile.headline: Looking for a Business Analyst, Data Scientist or Data Engineer position
profile.jobTitle: Airlines consultant, Software Engineer to Business Analyst, Data Engineer and Scientist profile
profile.summary: Passionate about Data , EAGER and READY to take on any new challenging Data projects !

positions.title: Airlines consultant, Software Engineer to Business Analyst, Data Engineer and Scientist profile
positions.description:
Data Science & Data Engineering Training : 
OBJECTIVE 
To be able to harmonize Big Data flows and machine/deep learning technologies in order   to build new data domains relationships, leading to implement data driven solutions that generate revenue growth, reduce costs and improve customer experience and productivity.
PROGRAM 
Understanding of Machine/Deep Learning techniques as well as Statistics and 
Probabilities. Development of regression, classification, and clustering models based on customer 
level data. Knowledge of Hadoop, Hive, Spark and NoSQL datastore like MongoDB and Redis. 
Expertise in Relational Databases, DB2, MySQL, SQL and Data mining. Experienced in Data 
Visualization with Cognos, Crystal Report and Excel. Working knowledge in Python. Familiarity with  Tableau, D3.js, R, Java, C++ and Go language.

positions.title: Database Design: Project "Package"
positions.description:
Database Design project - personal -	   
Definition of generic database structure reconciliating companies services/products inventories in one package only. Consider a customer request as a package describing multiple choices in terms of  itinerary of logistic services to organize a particular event from Home to Home. Query airline, hotel, private & public transportation, food, freight,...inventories from beginning to the end of a journey. Allow tracking, synchronization and communications between all service providers to support smoothly transfer of persons, products and  liability from one service to another. Structure strongly inspired by 25+ years of experience in the airline industry.

company.name: Approved to work in United States in April 2016.

positions.title: IT Manager & Software Engineering
positions.description:
Defined and implemented airlines IS Strategies. Delivered multiple projects on time and budget. Performed missions in Europe, Asia and USA for trainings, technical meetings and negotiations. Analyzed and implemented external software to replace in-house platform. Led a development, network and statistics team composed of 10 people. Supportive and communicative with teams to achieve goals.

AREAS of EXPERTISE
Field: Experienced in transportation/airline internal & external operational process.
Database: Relational, complex sql queries, expertise in data domains relationships 
Software engineering: Problem Solving, analyze, develop, implement & maintain applications.
Business analyst: process optimization & customer specifications definition. 
IT manager: IS Strategic Planning, Budgeting & Finance.
Network: Network & Data centers Design & Administration, Systems installation, integration & maintenance, Conversions & Migrations.
Team manager: Project Management, Team Building and Leadership, Cross-functional Team Coordination.

positions.title: Software Engineering
positions.description:
Developed and maintained in-house software platform processing all critical airlines sales and costs procedures such as Booking system, Checking, Freight, Packages, Payments, Cashbooks, Crew, Payroll, Statistics… Optimized business processes. Integrated SQL complex structured models.
Data Warehouse: Development of centralized database collating all data coming from production software to build statistics model via BI platforms like Crystal Report and Cognos.
 Experienced on technologies used: SQL, RPG, CLP, AS/400, OS/400, DB2. Windows Server, Windows 10, Office, Linux …
In-House Software: Examples of Achievements	
Performed in RPG II, III, IV and Free RPG running on AS/400 DB2
and Java, MySQL, SQL and Windows Server
. Airlines booking system
. Flight and Voyage/Hub Management
. Check-in and boarding module
. Cargo system
. Travel Product: hotels, transfer, event…deliver dynamic package and offer price & 
   availability on group of products listed in different revenue software inventories.
. Global cashbook management handling all types of payments revenue software inventories. 
. Human Resources & Payroll system
. Statistics & Info center
. Accounting system
. Asset Management connected to accounting system
. Invoice system connected to and accounting system 	
. Crew activities Management interfaced with Payroll 
. Y2K Compliance project successfully executed

educations.schoolName: Arts et Métiers - École Nationale Supérieure d'Arts et Métiers
educations.fieldOfStudy: Master of Science in Mechanical Engineering
Preparation to Engineering through high level of mathematics courses at J.B.SAY school, Paris, Franc
